entry_item.definition: v.i. To meet, present oneself to; to greet; to greet with xadaγ, q. v. , on the New Year ( a ceremonial greeting in which two persons exchange or touch xadaγs and at the same time exchange New Year's greetings).
1 se rencontrer, rencontrer, se voir: 2 visiter, faire visite à 3 complimenter, féliciter,
